title: Ambient complete rational and algebraically closed coefficient categories
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, write $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$, fix an algebraic closure $\Qlb$, and use the directed set $\mathsf{FinExt}_\ell$ of finite intermediate extensions [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $W$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible. For $E\in\mathsf{FinExt}_\ell$, write $A=\mathcal O_E$ and choose its uniformizer $\varpi_E$ as in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and use its completed coefficient sheaf $A_W$ and derived category of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $\mathcal B_E(W)$ be the full subcategory of $D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_W))$ of derived $(\varpi_E)$-complete objects, in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. Define
$$
 \mathcal R_E(W)=\mathcal B_E(W)[1/\varpi_E],\qquad
 \mathcal C_E(W)=D_{\mathrm{comp}}(W,E)=\Kar(\mathcal R_E(W)),
$$
using raw scalar localization [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization] and the Karoubi envelope [def-weil-karoubi-envelope]. Thus objects of $\mathcal R_E$ are complete integral objects and $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal R_E}(K,L)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B_E}(K,L)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E$; objects of $\mathcal C_E$ are $(K,p)$ with $p^2=p$ in this localized Hom group. The notation $D_{\mathrm{comp}}(W,E)$ in this definition denotes $\mathcal C_E(W)$. When a finite-stage theorem instead uses the raw ambient rationalization, that category is $\mathcal R_E(W)$; its maps are included here by $K\mapsto(K,1_K)$ and $u\mapsto u$. No equivalence of $\mathcal R_E(W)$ with its Karoubi envelope is assumed.

For $E\subset F$, the ambient integral scalar-extension functor is $C_{F/E,W}$ of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. On localized arrows send $u\otimes c$ to $C_{F/E,W}(u)\otimes c$, with $c\in E\subset F$; on Karoubi objects send $(K,p)$ to $(C_{F/E,W}K,C_{F/E,W}(p))$. Denote these transition functors by $T^W_{F/E}$. Use the tensor associators $a^W_{G,F,E}:T^W_{G/F}T^W_{F/E}\xrightarrow{\sim}T^W_{G/E}$ and normalized units, obtained from the same scalar-extension datum by localization and Karoubi extension.

Prescribe $\mathcal P^{\mathrm{amb}}_W$ by objects $(E,K)$ with $K\in\mathcal C_E(W)$. A morphism $(E,K)\to(F,L)$ is a class $[M,u]$, with $M\supset E,F$ a finite coefficient field and $u:T^W_{M/E}K\to T^W_{M/F}L$. For $N\supset M$ put
$$
 u_N=a^W_{N,M,F,L}\circ T^W_{N/M}(u)\circ(a^W_{N,M,E,K})^{-1}.
$$
Two representatives are identified when their transported arrows agree at some further finite overfield. The identity is $[E,1_K]$; addition and composition are prescribed by addition and composition at a common finite overfield. Take the additive pair category supplied by [lem-sbc-coherent-pair-functor-descent] for these coherent data. Define
$$D_{\mathrm{comp}}(W,\Qlb)=\Kar(\mathcal P^{\mathrm{amb}}_W).$$
The inclusion of the constructible raw rational category [def-weil-pbc-rational-category] into $\mathcal R_E(W)$, followed by $K\mapsto(K,1_K)$, prescribes the ambient image of a constructible finite-stage object. A constructible pair $(E,K)\in\Dbc(W,\Qlb)$ [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category] is sent to the corresponding ambient pair with identity outer idempotent. On a represented morphism $[M,u]$, let $j_M$ denote the integral full-subcategory inclusion. Its scalar localization sends $u=\sum_i u_i\otimes c_i$ to $\sum_i j_M(u_i)\otimes c_i$; apply the identity-idempotent inclusion to this localized arrow and take its ambient common-stage class. Use the scalar-extension comparisons of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension] to identify its source and target with the scalar extensions of the two ambient image objects. This specifies an ambient coefficient construction; it does not impose constructible bounds on its objects.
